name: Gomu Gomu no Mi (Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika)
abilities: Grants the user's body the properties of rubber, allowing them to stretch, bounce, and be immune to blunt attacks and electricity. Awakened form (Gear Fifth) allows reality-warping abilities and brings joy and freedom.
strengths: Enhanced physical abilities in Gear forms
weaknesses: Vulnerable to cutting and piercing attacks
Standard Devil Fruit weakness to seawater
Gear forms can cause physical strain
Requires creativity to maximize potential
description: Originally thought to be the Gomu Gomu no Mi (Rubber-Rubber Fruit), it was revealed to be the mythical Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika. This legendary fruit grants the powers of the Sun God Nika, bringing liberation and joy. It is one of the most sought-after Devil Fruits by the World Government.

name: Hito Hito no Mi
abilities: Allows an animal to transform into a human hybrid and full human form, granting human intelligence and abilities.
strengths: Enhanced physical abilities in hybrid form
weaknesses: Standard Devil Fruit weakness to seawater
Limited combat advantage for humans
Rumble Ball dependency for extra forms
description: A Zoan-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to transform into a human. When eaten by an animal like Chopper, it grants human intelligence, speech, and the ability to walk upright. Chopper has developed multiple transformation points using the Rumble Ball.

name: Hana Hana no Mi
abilities: Allows the user to sprout duplicates of their body parts on any surface within range, including living beings and objects.
strengths: Extreme versatility in combat and utility
Demonio Fleur form for enhanced power
Excellent for espionage and information gathering
weaknesses: Damage to sprouted parts is felt by the user
Standard Devil Fruit weakness to seawater
Requires concentration for complex formations
Limited by user's physical stamina
description: The Flower-Flower Fruit allows Robin to sprout parts of her body anywhere within her range. She can create eyes and ears for spying, hands for grabbing, or even giant limbs for powerful attacks. Her awakened Demonio Fleur form grants her even greater power.

name: Yomi Yomi no Mi
abilities: Grants the user a second life after death, allowing their soul to return to their body. Also grants soul-based powers.
weaknesses: Resurrection only works once
Standard Devil Fruit weakness to seawater
Soul must find body after death
Limited offensive power without training
description: The Revive-Revive Fruit grants the user a second chance at life. After Brook died, his soul wandered for a year before finding his body, which had already decomposed to bones. He later learned to use his soul energy for attacks and can even leave his body temporarily.

name: Mera Mera no Mi
abilities: Allows the user to create, control, and transform into fire at will.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to magma (superior element)
Standard Devil Fruit weakness to seawater
Can be countered by Haki users
Water-based attacks are problematic
description: The Flame-Flame Fruit is a powerful Logia-type that grants complete control over fire. Originally eaten by Portgas D. Ace, it was later inherited by Sabo after Ace's death. The fruit allows devastating fire attacks and Logia-type intangibility.

name: Ope Ope no Mi
abilities: Allows the user to create a spherical territory (Room) where they can manipulate anything, including spatial positioning, object properties, and even personalities.
strengths: Can grant immortality (at cost of user's life)
weaknesses: Drains stamina significantly
Room has size limitations
Standard Devil Fruit weakness to seawater
Requires surgical knowledge for full potential
Immortality surgery kills the user
description: The Op-Op Fruit is considered the 'Ultimate Devil Fruit' due to its ability to grant immortality through a special surgery. Law uses it to create Rooms where he can manipulate space, switch objects, and perform miraculous medical procedures. It's worth 5 billion berries on the black market.

name: Suna Suna no Mi
abilities: Allows the user to create, control, and transform into sand at will.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to water and liquids
Standard Devil Fruit weakness to seawater
Can be countered by Haki users
Less effective in humid environments
description: The Sand-Sand Fruit grants the user complete control over sand. Crocodile can transform into sand to avoid attacks, create massive sandstorms, and absorb moisture from anything he touches. Water is his primary weakness, as it solidifies the sand.

name: Ito Ito no Mi
abilities: Allows the user to create and manipulate strings that can be used for cutting, controlling people, or creating clones.
weaknesses: Standard Devil Fruit weakness to seawater
Strings can be cut by strong attacks
Requires concentration for complex techniques
Awakening drains stamina
description: The String-String Fruit allows Doflamingo to create and control razor-sharp strings. He can use them to control people, create clones, fly by attaching strings to clouds, and even repair internal organs. His awakening allows him to turn his surroundings into strings.

name: Uo Uo no Mi, Model: Seiryu
abilities: Allows the user to transform into an Azure Dragon, granting flight, flame breath, lightning generation, and immense physical power.
strengths: Massive size and strength in dragon form
Hybrid form combines power and mobility
weaknesses: Large size makes an easy target
Standard Devil Fruit weakness to seawater
Can be countered by advanced Haki
Transformation drains energy
description: A Mythical Zoan fruit that allows transformation into an Azure Dragon, one of the rarest and most powerful Devil Fruits. Kaido uses it to create devastating attacks and fly using flame clouds. The dragon form grants immense power and various elemental abilities.

name: Soru Soru no Mi
abilities: Allows the user to interact with and manipulate souls, including extracting them from people and placing them into objects or animals to create homies.
strengths: Can extract souls from fearful people
Can use own soul for power boosts
Special homies (Zeus, Prometheus, Hera) are extremely powerful
weaknesses: Cannot extract souls from fearless people
Standard Devil Fruit weakness to seawater
Homies can be destroyed
Requires fear to be most effective
Using own soul shortens lifespan
description: The Soul-Soul Fruit allows Big Mom to manipulate souls. She can extract souls from people who fear her, use fragments of her own soul to create powerful homies, and even steal years from people's lifespans. Her special homies Zeus, Prometheus, and Hera are incredibly powerful.
